boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Alabama in Huntsville

cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when plans run late; the official location page lists service until 4 AM every day, while dine-in ends earlier.
cards.short_summary: A University Drive drive-thru with documented 4 AM service.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Taco Bell location page lists drive-thru hours of 9 AM–4 AM daily at 4315 University Dr NW.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 9 AM–4 AM daily. Dine-in hours are shorter; the official page lists 9 AM–10 PM.
